verses.pali: “Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, pamuṭṭhaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati pamuṭṭhā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, those who have forgotten mindfulness of the body have forgotten freedom from death.

verses.pali: Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, appamuṭṭhaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati appamuṭṭhā”ti.
verses.english: Those who haven’t forgotten mindfulness of the body haven’t forgotten freedom from death.”
